host_mode: C89 pedantic-errors, Wall/Wextra/Werror, AddressSanitizer, UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer and float-cast-overflow
leak_sanitizer: Disabled only for executor ptrace incompatibility; no candidate or harness heap allocation. Address/UB checks remain enabled.
native_width_checks: Temporary IDO assertions pass for uint4, ushort2, float4 and double8. Host checks IEEE binary32/binary64 widths; E940 reference additionally uses host unsigned-long width at least64.
limits: Synthetic scalar/table fixtures do not identify original external values. Float casts use finite representable truncation domains; phase signed-short wrap follows N64 two's complement. Valid sorted bounded objects and nonoverflowing arithmetic are required for search. E940 requires valid objects and a nonzero rate. No malformed-input, concurrency or whole-game claim.
